description.zh: 文明演化的流程定义骨架（Phase D 草案）。基于口播稿与英文规则书，先建立 Setup、4 时代 × 8 阶段、终局计分的整体流程；具体 action/trigger/condition 细节在 concepts.json 中补全。
description.en: Flow definition skeleton for Civolution (Phase D draft). Based on the Chinese script and English rulebook; establishes Setup, 4 eras × 8 phases, and final scoring. Detailed actions/triggers/conditions will be filled in concepts.json.

description.zh: 游戏设置阶段，分为公共设置和个人设置。
description.en: Game setup phase, divided into public setup and player setup.

description.zh: 拼接 4 片外框形成<score_track>，将 8 块<continent_tile>随机排列铺满<score_track>内部的 5×3 网格，形成<continent>。
description.en: Move the score track frame pieces and continent tiles into the score track area: assemble the 4 frame pieces into the score track, randomly arrange the 8 continent tiles to fill the 5×3 grid inside it, forming the continent.

description.zh: 将 24 块<site>背面朝上随机放在<continent>的<site_slot>中。
description.en: Place the 24 site tiles face down on the site spaces of the continent.

description.zh: 将<progress_board>和<sequence_board>分别放置在<public_board>两侧。
description.en: Place the progress board and sequence board on either side of the public board.

description.zh: 将<phase_indicator>放到<sequence_board>的<phase_sequence>上<phase_1_new_cards>位置。
description.en: Place the phase indicator on phase 1 of the sequence board's phase sequence.

description.zh: 将<weather_indicator>放到<sequence_board>的<weather_gauge>上<weather_gauge.mild>位置。
description.en: Place the weather indicator on a moderate space of the weather gauge.

description.zh: 洗混 20 张<event_card>成堆，从堆顶抽 4 张背面朝上放在<sequence_board>的<event_card_space>上，其余放回<ontology::game_box>。
description.en: Shuffle the 20 event cards into a stack, draw 4 from the top, and place them face down on the event card spaces; return the rest to the box.

description.zh: 将五种<research_card>分别洗混后形成<research_deck>。
description.en: Shuffle the five types of research cards into separate supply decks.

description.zh: 洗混<starting_marker_card>和<starting_chip_card>备用。
description.en: Shuffle the starting marker deck and starting chip deck.

description.zh: 从<ontology::game_box>中的<scoring_tile>中随机盲抽 4 张，正面朝上放入<era_scoring_area>（<scoring_tile>不成堆，随机抽取）。
description.en: Blindly draw 4 scoring tiles at random from the game box and place them face up in the era scoring area (scoring tiles are not a stack; drawn at random).

description.zh: 从剩余<scoring_tile>中随机盲抽 3 张，检视图标面，按图标匹配放到<final_scoring_area_icons>对应格下方（覆盖该格印的默认分值），翻至分数面朝上——<final_scoring>时该类别的分值取板块上的分数（被覆盖的格不再用印的分值）。
description.en: Blindly draw 3 scoring tiles at random from the remaining ones, inspect their icon sides, place each below its matching icon slot in the final scoring area (covering the printed default value of that space), and flip them point side up — the tile's points apply at final scoring (the covered space's printed value no longer counts).

description.zh: 从游戏盒中的剩余计分板块随机盲抽 3 张，检视图标面（暂不放置）。
description.en: Blindly draw 3 scoring tiles at random from the remaining ones in the game box and inspect their icon sides (not placed yet).

description.zh: 将刚抽出的计分板块按图标面匹配，放到 <final_scoring_area_icons> 对应图标格下方——覆盖该格印的默认分值，以分数面朝上放置（终局计分时该类别的分值取板块上的分数）。
description.en: Place the drawn scoring tiles below their matching icon slots in the <final_scoring_area_icons>, covering the printed default value of each space, point side up (the tile's points apply at final scoring).

<ontology::replaces>.target: <final_scoring_area_icons> 各图标格下方印的默认分值空间（point space，图标匹配者）

description.zh: 将<hundred_point_token>作为<ontology::supply>放到<hundred_point_token_display>。2 人局将部分指示物翻至阻挡面，覆盖<goal_chip_display> 2 个格和<phase_sequence>的 4 个带人数标记<reset_space>；3 人局覆盖<goal_chip_display> 1 个格和 2 个带 4 人标记的<reset_space>；4 人局不覆盖。
description.en: Place the 100-point tokens as a supply on the 100-point token display. In a 2-player game, flip some blocking side up to cover 2 goal chip display spaces and the 4 player-count-marked <reset_space>s of <phase_sequence>; in 3-player, cover 1 goal chip display space and the 2 spaces marked 4; in 4-player, cover none.

description.zh: 2 人局取 10 个<hunting_token>翻至阻挡面，覆盖<continent>上带特殊图标的<encampment>；3 人局覆盖 4 个带对应图标的<encampment>；4 人局不覆盖。其余<hunting_token>翻至正面，作为通用狩猎指示物<ontology::supply>放到<hunting_token_display>。
description.en: In a 2-player game, flip 10 territory tokens blocking side up to cover the encampments marked with the special icons; in 3-player, cover the 4 encampments with the marked icon; in 4-player, cover none. Flip the remaining tokens front side up as the general hunting token supply in the hunting token display.

description.zh: 拿取玩家数量 +1 的<activation_die>和<fate_die>，放到<progress_board>.parts.<dice_display>。
description.en: Take player_count + 1 activation dice and fate dice, place them in the progress board supply.

description.zh: 从<goal_chip_bag>中随机盲抽<goal_chip>，正面朝上放到<goal_chip_display>的每个可用格：4 人局 6 张、3 人局 5 张、2 人局 4 张（2/3 人局中带人数标记的格——3 人标记格仅 ≥3 人局使用、4 人标记格仅 4 人局使用——已被<hundred_point_token>阻挡标记覆盖）。
description.en: Blindly draw goal chips from the dark blue bag and place them face up on each usable space of the goal chip display: 6 for 4p, 5 for 3p, 4 for 2p (in 2/3-player games, spaces with player-count marks — the 3-marked space is used only in 3+ player games and the 4-marked space only in 4-player games — are covered by blocking tokens).

description.zh: 从<income_chip_bag>中随机盲抽<income_chip>，正面朝上放到<income_chip_display>的每个格（共 3 格）。
description.en: Blindly draw income chips from the white bag and place them face up on each of the 3 spaces of the income chip display.

description.zh: 从<attribute_chip_bag>中随机盲抽<attribute_chip>，正面朝上放到<attribute_chip_display>的每个格（共 3 格）。
description.en: Blindly draw attribute chips from the yellow bag and place them face up on each of the 3 spaces of the attribute chip display.

description.zh: 将所有<material_tile>背面朝上按颜色随机放到<continent_tile>的<material_slot>上；放到标有「Start」（初始）字样的<material_slot>上的板块翻至正面朝上。
description.en: Place all material tiles face down on the continent's material spaces by color randomly; tiles placed on spaces marked 'Start' are flipped face up.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 15 个<upgradable_module>并翻至等级一面，放入<console>的<module_area>。
description.en: Each player takes 15 main modules, flips them to level I, and places them in the module area.

description.zh: 每位玩家从游戏盒中拿取 6 个<activation_die>，分别翻至 ⚀⚁⚂⚃⚄⚅ 六个面，放到<console>.parts.<activation_dice_area>对应点数格上。
description.en: Each player takes 6 activation dice from the game box, sets them to show each value 1-6, and places each on the corresponding dice space of their console.

description.zh: 每位玩家从<ontology::game_box>中拿取 1 个<fate_die>放在<console>旁边备用。
description.en: Each player takes 1 fate die from the game box and places it beside their console.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取层级四和层级五的<stage_tile>，未激活面朝上放到<console>对应位置。
description.en: Each player takes stage-4 and stage-5 tiles, inactive side up, and places them on the console.

description.zh: 每位玩家将 4 个<settlement>、3 个<farm>和 2 艘<boat>放入<console>左侧对应凹槽，并在每艘<boat>的凹槽中各放 1 个<octagonal_pillar>。
description.en: Each player places their 4 settlements, 3 farms, and 2 boats into the recesses on the left side of the console, and places 1 marker in the notch of each boat.

description.zh: 每位玩家将 7 个<stackable_disc>放到<public_board>上：1 个<score_marker>放到<score_track> 0 分位置、1 个<favor_marker>放到<favor_of_ager_track>起始位置、5 个<progress_marker>分别放到 5 条<progress_track>的 0 格。
description.en: Each player places their 7 discs on the game boards: 1 score marker on the score track at 0, 1 favor marker on the <favor_of_ager_track> start, and 5 progress markers on the 5 progress tracks at 0.

description.zh: 每位玩家将 2 个<tribe>直立放到两个初始区域中不带篝火的空置<encampment>。
description.en: Each player places 2 tribes upright on empty non-campfire campsites in the two initial territories.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿 6 个标记：2 个<octagonal_pillar>放到<continent>两个初始区域中<encampment>以外位置，4 个<reset_marker>放到<console>的<reset_column>顶部。
description.en: Each player takes 6 markers: 2 to non-campsite spaces in the two initial territories, 4 to the reset column top of the console.

description.zh: 随机选择一名玩家，将<ontology::starting_player>状态设为该玩家。
description.en: Randomly choose one player and set <ontology::starting_player> to that player.

description.zh: 起始玩家获得<starting_monolith>。
description.en: The starting player receives the starting monolith.

description.zh: 每位玩家抽 3 张<starting_marker_card>，秘密检视后选 1 张，按所选牌的指示从<ontology::supply>取标记放置（获得标记），随后 3 张<starting_marker_card>全部放回<ontology::game_box>。
description.en: Each player draws 3 starting marker cards, secretly inspects them, chooses 1, gains the indicated markers (taken from supply and placed per the card), then returns all 3 starting marker cards to the game box.

description.zh: 每位玩家从洗好的初始标记牌堆顶部抽 3 张，秘密检视后选 1 张。
description.en: Each player draws 3 starting marker cards from the top of the shuffled deck, inspects them secretly, and chooses 1.

description.zh: 按所选初始标记牌的指示，从供应堆取对应数量的标记放到控制台对应空格。
description.en: Take the number of markers indicated by the chosen starting marker card from supply and place them on the corresponding console spaces.

<ontology::transfer>.quantity: 按所选标记牌指示的数量与位置

description.zh: 3 张初始标记牌全部放回盒子。
description.en: Return all 3 starting marker cards to the game box.

description.zh: 翻开玩家数量 +1 张<starting_chip_card>，每张牌上放置一枚<goal_chip>（牌与芯片绑定，必须一起选走）；从起始玩家右手边玩家开始逆时针轮抽，每位玩家选一张牌：将其上的<goal_chip>放入<goal_area>、将牌中三分之一记录的<upgradable_module>升级至等级二、最后将牌塞入<income_area>成为首个<income_chip>。
description.en: Reveal player_count + 1 starting chip cards and place a goal chip on each (card and chip are bound — drafted together); starting with the player right of the starting player and going counter-clockwise, each player drafts 1 card: place its goal chip into the goal area, upgrade the module shown on the card's middle third to level 2, and finally slide the card into the income area as the first income chip.

description.zh: 从洗好的初始芯片牌堆顶部翻开玩家数量 +1 张，正面朝上展示。
description.en: Reveal player_count + 1 starting chip cards from the top of the shuffled deck, face up.

description.zh: 从深蓝袋盲抽目标芯片，在每张翻开的初始芯片牌上各放一枚。所有牌都放好芯片后才开始轮抽。
description.en: Blindly draw goal chips from the dark blue bag and place one on each revealed starting chip card. Drafting starts only after every card has its chip.

description.zh: 一轮轮抽：每位玩家一个 turn，从起始玩家右手边玩家开始逆时针依次选择一张展示的<starting_chip_card>（牌连同其上的<goal_chip>一起选走）。
description.en: One draft round: one turn per player, starting with the player right of the starting player and going counter-clockwise; each player drafts one revealed starting chip card (card and its goal chip taken together).

description.zh: 从展示的<starting_chip_card>中选一张（连同其上的<goal_chip>）。
description.en: Choose one revealed starting chip card (with its goal chip).

description.zh: 将选中的牌上的目标芯片正面朝上放入目标区。
description.en: Place the goal chip from the chosen card face up into the goal area.

description.zh: 将牌中三分之一记录的模组升级至等级二（翻面）——玩家的首个升级模组。
description.en: Upgrade the module shown on the card's middle third to level 2 (flip it) — the player's first upgraded module.

<ontology::state_change>.subject: 选中的<starting_chip_card>中三分之一记录的模组

description.zh: 将选中的初始芯片牌塞入收入区成为首个收入芯片。
description.en: Slide the chosen starting chip card into the income area as the first income chip.

description.zh: 每位玩家从五个<research_deck>各抽 2 张（共 10 张），每种类型选 1 张保留入手牌，未选的 5 张放回各自来源牌堆底部。
description.en: Each player draws 2 cards from each of the 5 research decks (10 total), keeps 1 of each type in hand, and returns the 5 unchosen cards to the bottoms of their respective source decks.

description.zh: 每位玩家从每个研究牌堆的顶部各抽 2 张。
description.en: Each player draws 2 cards from the top of each of the 5 research decks.

quantity.zh: 每个研究牌堆各抽 2 张（5 堆共 10 张）。
quantity.en: 2 from each of the 5 research decks (10 total).

description.zh: 每种类型（建造/洞悉/突变/成就/发明）从抽到的 2 张中选 1 张保留入手牌。
description.en: For each type (Building/Insight/Mutation/Achievement/Invention), choose 1 of the 2 drawn cards to keep in hand.

description.zh: 将未选中的 5 张研究牌（每种 1 张）面朝下放回各自来源牌堆底部。
description.en: Return the 5 unchosen research cards (1 per type) face down to the bottoms of their respective source decks.

<ontology::transfer>.source: 每种类型未选中的 1 张<research_card>

description.zh: 游戏共进行 4 个时代（loop.count 4），每个时代包含 8 个阶段。
description.en: The game consists of 4 eras (loop.count 4), each with 8 phases.

description.zh: 阶段一：新的卡牌。翻开<event_card>堆顶部一张（覆盖上时代的<event_card>），显示本时代天气变化方向和事件效果。然后翻开 5 个<research_deck>各顶部一张，放到对应的<face_up_research_stack>上（第一时代新建堆，后续覆盖上时代<research_card>）。
description.en: Phase 1: New Cards. Reveal the top card of the face-down event stack (covering the previous era's event card), showing this era's weather change direction and event effect. Then reveal the top card from each of the 5 face-down research stacks onto the corresponding face-up research stack (forming new stacks in era 1, covering the previous card thereafter).

description.zh: 翻开背面朝上事件牌堆顶部一张，正面朝上放到左边事件牌格。右上角显示本时代天气变化方向（向 Hot 或 Cold 移动一步或两步）与事件效果——事件在阶段 7 结算。
description.en: Reveal the top card of the face-down event stack and place it face up on the left event card space. Its top-right corner shows this era's weather change direction (one or two steps toward Hot or Cold) and the event effect — resolved in phase 7.

<ontology::top_draw>.source: <event_card_space> 的背面朝上事件牌堆（右格）
<ontology::top_draw>.destination: <event_card_space> 的正面朝上展示堆（左格，第一时代直接放置，后续覆盖上一时代事件牌）

description.zh: 翻开 5 个背面朝下研究牌堆各顶部一张：第一时代放到对应背面堆旁形成正面朝上堆，后续时代放到对应正面朝上堆顶部覆盖上一张。
description.en: Reveal the top card of each of the 5 face-down research decks: in era 1, placed next to its deck to form the face-up stack; in later eras, placed on top of the corresponding face-up stack, covering the previous card.

quantity.zh: 每个研究牌堆各 1 张（共 5 张）。
quantity.en: 1 from each of the 5 research decks (5 total).

description.zh: 阶段二：新的目标。从起始玩家开始顺时针，每位玩家可选择从<goal_chip_display>拿取一枚<goal_chip>放入<goal_area>，或跳过。所有玩家选择完成后，补满<goal_chip_display>空位。
description.en: Phase 2: New Goals. Starting with the start player and going clockwise, each player may take a goal chip from the display into the goal area, or decline. After every player has chosen, refill the empty display spaces.

description.zh: 一轮选择：每位玩家一个 turn，从起始玩家开始顺时针轮流。
description.en: One choice round: one turn per player, starting with the starting player and going clockwise.

description.zh: 放弃（跳过此项）
description.en: Decline (skip)

description.zh: 从展示区拿 1 枚目标芯片正面朝上放入目标区；目标区 3 格已满时叠放在任意 1 枚已有目标芯片上并覆盖之（被覆盖者直到其上芯片被安装前不可用）。
description.en: Take 1 goal chip from the display and place it face up in the goal area; if all 3 spaces are occupied, place it on top of another face-up goal chip, covering it (the covered chip is unusable until the chip on top is installed).

description.zh: 所有玩家都做出选择后，从深蓝袋盲抽目标芯片补满展示区的空位。
description.en: After every player has had the opportunity to choose, blindly draw goal chips from the dark blue bag to refill the empty display spaces.

description.zh: 阶段三：额外收获。按座次（起始玩家开始顺时针），每位玩家选择 1 个有至少一个自己 <tribe> 的<territory>，从<ontology::supply>取 1 个标记作为 <stored_material> 放到<storage_area>中与所选<territory>地形类型对应的存储格。只按<territory>地形类型匹配，与<material_tile>印的具体材料无关。
description.en: Phase 3: Extra Find. In seating order (starting player then clockwise), each player chooses 1 land territory where they have at least one <tribe>, takes 1 marker from supply as a <stored_material>, and places it on a storage space matching the chosen territory's terrain type. Only the territory type matters, not the material depicted on the material tile.

description.zh: 一轮额外收获：每位玩家一个 turn，从起始玩家开始顺时针（按座次）。
description.en: One extra-find round: one turn per player, starting with the starting player and going clockwise (seating order).

description.zh: 阶段四：行动阶段。<phase_indicator>从第一个黄色<reset_space>开始。从起始玩家顺时针轮流转，每回合必须二选一：<activate_module>（支付恰好 2 个对应点数的<activation_die>或<planning_marker>/<focus_marker>）或执行<reset>（前提：当前<activation_dice_area>的<activation_die>不超过 3 个）。<reset>分三步——A: 沿黄色箭头推动<phase_indicator>到下一个<reset_space>（若到达<reset_end_space>则触发行动阶段结束流程）；B: 回收已使用的骰子并全部重掷；C: 将最左侧<reset_marker>移入<idea_space>或<food_space>。行动阶段在「标记被推至<reset_end_space>的那一轮 + 下一轮」都结束后才结束（见<action_phase_end>）；结束后将<phase_indicator>推到<phase_5_site>。
description.en: Phase 4: Action Phase. The phase indicator starts on the first yellow <reset_space>. Players take turns clockwise; each turn must either activate a module (pay exactly 2 activation dice of matching values, or planning/focus markers) or perform a Reset (only if the player has ≤3 activation dice on dice spaces). Reset has three steps — A: Advance the phase indicator along the yellow arrow to the next <reset_space> (if it reaches the <reset_end_space>, the Action Phase end sequence is triggered); B: Retrieve all used dice and re-roll them; C: Move the leftmost reset marker to the idea space or food space. The Action phase ends only after both the round in which the phase indicator was pushed onto the <reset_end_space> AND the following round have completed (see <action_phase_end>); afterwards the <phase_indicator> is advanced to Phase 5.

description.zh: 行动阶段结束后（触发轮与最终行动轮均已完成，起始玩家右手边的玩家完成最后一回合），将<phase_indicator>从<phase_sequence>.<phase_4_action>[9]（第 10 格，<reset_end_space>）推进到<phase_sequence>.<phase_5_site>[0]（第 1 格，<phase_5_site>）。
description.en: After the Action phase ends (both the triggering round and the final action round completed, with the player right of the starting player finishing their last turn), advance the <phase_indicator> from <phase_sequence>.<phase_4_action>[9] (the 10th space, <reset_end_space>) to <phase_sequence>.<phase_5_site>[0] (the 1st space, Site phase).

description.zh: 阶段五：地点阶段。依次结算三种已翻开<site>的 continuous_effect——A) 狼谷（<gorge_of_grimwolves>）；B) 冰川（<glacier>）；C) 神秘橡树（<mystic_oak>）。未翻开的<site>跳过。
description.en: Phase 5: Site Phase. Resolve the continuous_effects of the three revealed site types in order — A) Gorge of the Grimwolves (<gorge_of_grimwolves>); B) Glacier (<glacier>); C) Mystic oak (<mystic_oak>). Sites not revealed are skipped.

description.zh: 结算所有已翻开<gorge_of_grimwolves>的 continuous_effect：与狼谷相邻的<territory>中有自己<tribe>且<food_space>有<food>的玩家，各失去 1 个<food>（无<food>豁免）。
description.en: Resolve the continuous_effect of every revealed <gorge_of_grimwolves>: each player who has a tribe in an adjacent territory and food on the food space loses 1 food (exempt if without food).

description.zh: 结算所有已翻开<glacier>的 continuous_effect：相邻<territory>中有强壮<tribe>的玩家，虚弱（躺倒）其中一个强壮<tribe>（弱<tribe>不受影响，无强壮<tribe>豁免）。
description.en: Resolve the continuous_effect of every revealed <glacier>: each player who has a strong tribe in an adjacent territory weakens (lays down) one of those strong tribes (weak tribes are never affected; players without strong adjacent tribes are exempt).

description.zh: 结算所有已翻开<mystic_oak>的 continuous_effect：对每块橡树，每位玩家按相邻且有自己<tribe>的<territory>计分——水/沼泽/沙漠<territory>各 2 分，森林/草原/丘陵/山脉<territory>各 1 分。
description.en: Resolve the continuous_effect of every revealed <mystic_oak>: for each oak, each player scores 2 points per adjacent Water/Swamp/Desert area and 1 point per adjacent Forest/Grassland/Hill/Mountain area holding one of their tribes.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 匹配依据：各地点类型是否已翻开（face == face_up）——翻开的地点类型结算其效果，未翻开的不结算（命中候选按 options 顺序依次结算）。
<ontology::condition>.en: Matching basis: whether each site type is revealed (face == face_up) — revealed site types resolve their effects, unrevealed ones do not (matched candidates resolve in options order).

description.zh: 阶段六：喂养阶段。两步：A) 喂部落——<continent>上所有<tribe>必须喂食（可同时进行）；B) 强壮<tribe>得分。
description.en: Phase 6: Feeding Phase. Two steps: A) Feed tribes — all tribes on the continent must be fed (may be done simultaneously); B) Score strong tribes.

description.zh: 对本玩家的每个<tribe>确定喂食成本并决定是否支付：<encampment>上或<boat>上的<tribe> 1 <food>，野外（<encampment>外）<tribe> 2 <food>；自己<farm>所在<territory>的<encampment><tribe>自动视为已喂饱、野外<tribe>只需 1 <food>；<research_card>能力可进一步减免。支付 = 从<food_space>返还对应数量<food>至<ontology::supply>。未喂饱的<tribe>：强壮（posture == <upright>）<tribe>躺倒（<lying>），已弱（<lying>）<tribe>死亡——触发<tribe_death>（此时可用<deus_ex_machina>拯救）。
description.en: For each of this player's tribes, determine the feeding cost and decide whether to pay: 1 food per tribe on an <encampment> or <boat>, 2 food per tribe in the wilderness (outside encampments); tribes on encampments in a territory with your own <farm> are automatically fed, wilderness tribes there cost 1 food; research card abilities may reduce costs further. Paying = returning that many <food> from <food_space> to the supply. Unfed tribes: strong (<upright>) tribes are laid down (<lying>); already weak (<lying>) tribes die — triggering <tribe_death> (<deus_ex_machina> may save them then).

description.zh: 对每个决定喂饱的部落，按成本从<food_space>返还<food>至供应堆（营地/船 1、野外 2、农场与研究牌减免）。
description.en: For each tribe you choose to feed, return <food> from <food_space> to the supply at its cost (1 for encampment/boat, 2 for wilderness, reduced by farms and research cards).

<ontology::transfer>.quantity: 按各部落成本之和（营地/船 1、野外 2、农场/研究牌减免）

description.zh: 所有玩家完成喂部落（A 步）后，每位玩家为自己的每个强壮（posture == <upright>）<tribe>获得 1 分。
description.en: After every player has finished feeding (step A), each player gains 1 success point for each of their strong (<upright>) tribes.

<ontology::push_track>.step: 强壮部落数量（每个 1 分）

description.zh: 阶段七：事件阶段。依次执行：A) 调整天气并结算其效果；B) 结算<event_card>效果；C) 按当前时代<scoring_tile>的类别计分；D) 确定新的起始玩家（刚在该类别得分最高者）。
description.en: Phase 7: Event Phase. Execute in order: A) adjust the weather and resolve its effect; B) resolve the event card effect; C) score the current era's scoring category; D) determine the new starting player (highest scorer of that category).

description.zh: A 步：调整天气并结算其效果——先按本时代<event_card>右上角的 <weather_trend> 移动 <weather_indicator>，再按座次顺位逐一结算 <weather_gauge> 当前格的效果。
description.en: Step A: adjust the weather and resolve its effect — first move the <weather_indicator> per the <weather_trend> on this era's event card, then resolve the current <weather_gauge> space effect in seating order.

description.zh: 结算本时代正面朝上 <event_card> 的天气效果（右上角 <weather_trend> part）：将 <weather_indicator> 沿 <weather_gauge> 按牌面指示移动 1 或 2 步（变热向热端、变冷向冷端）。白线规则（越线停靠 <weather_gauge.hot_beyond>/<weather_gauge.cold_beyond>）见 <weather_trend> 定义。本步骤执行完毕后，由 <weather_effect> 按标记所在格结算天气效果（越线格效果含推回极端格）。
description.en: Resolve the weather effect of this era's face-up <event_card> (its <weather_trend> part): move the <weather_indicator> along the <weather_gauge> by the 1 or 2 steps shown on the card (toward Hot when warming, toward Cold when cooling). The white-line rule (over-line stop on <weather_gauge.hot_beyond>/<weather_gauge.cold_beyond>) is defined on <weather_trend>. After this step completes, <weather_effect> resolves the weather effect of the slot the indicator is on (the over-line slot's effect includes pushing back to the extreme space).

description.zh: B 步：结算本时代正面朝上的 <event_card> 的事件效果（<event_card>.parts.<event_effect>，其 effect 自带 <ontology::condition> 与 <ontology::content>）：condition 成立时结算 content，给予一个或多个文明奖励——奖励适用于多个文明时，各文明按座次顺位逐一获得；奖励只指向一个特定文明时，仅在该文明可明确识别时授予；无文明满足条件则作废。少数事件的 condition 包含移除 <farm> 或 <boat>。
description.en: Step B: resolve the event effect of this era's face-up <event_card> (<event_card>.parts.<event_effect>, whose effect carries its own <ontology::condition> and <ontology::content>): when the condition holds, the content is resolved, granting a bonus to one or more civilizations — when the bonus applies to multiple civilizations, each gains it in seating order; a bonus rewarding one specific civilization is awarded only if that civilization is unambiguously identifiable; if no civilization meets the condition, the bonus is forfeited. A few events' conditions require removing <farm>s or <boat>s.

description.zh: C 步：按当前时代的计分类别计分，计分完成后移除该<scoring_tile>。
description.en: Step C: score the current era's category, then remove that scoring tile.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 事件阶段进行到 C 步（时代计分环节）时。
<ontology::condition>.en: The Event phase has reached step C (era scoring).

description.zh: 每位玩家按当前时代计分板块（<era_scoring_area> 最左非空格的 <scoring_tile>）显示的类别结算计分：9 个类别候选由规则按板块类别匹配，命中的类别执行——板块类别为当前局面状态，需向客人确认；按该类别「每有 X 个 Y 得 Z 分」规则得分（Z = 板块显示的每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Each player scores per the category shown on the current era's scoring tile (the leftmost non-empty space of the <era_scoring_area>): the rules match the tile's category against the 9 category candidates, and the matched candidate executes — the tile's category is current board state and must be confirmed with the players; score per that category's "gain Z points per X of Y" rule (Z = the per-item value on the tile), gained on the <score_track>.

description.zh: 每有 1 个 <technology_track> 轨道步数（圆盘所在格的数字），得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each progress-track step (the digit printed on your disc's space on the <technology_track>), on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家圆盘在 <technology_track> 所在格数字 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个 <prestige_track> 轨道步数（圆盘所在格的数字），得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each progress-track step (the digit printed on your disc's space on the <prestige_track>), on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家圆盘在 <prestige_track> 所在格数字 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个 <knowledge_track> 轨道步数（圆盘所在格的数字），得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each progress-track step (the digit printed on your disc's space on the <knowledge_track>), on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家圆盘在 <knowledge_track> 所在格数字 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个 <construction_track> 轨道步数（圆盘所在格的数字），得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each progress-track step (the digit printed on your disc's space on the <construction_track>), on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家圆盘在 <construction_track> 所在格数字 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个 <culture_track> 轨道步数（圆盘所在格的数字），得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each progress-track step (the digit printed on your disc's space on the <culture_track>), on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家圆盘在 <culture_track> 所在格数字 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个特征格上的 <feature_marker>，得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each <feature_marker> on your feature spaces, on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家 <feature_marker> 总数 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个活跃钻石，得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。活跃钻石 = <console> 左半——<food_space> 每 3 枚 <food> 1 钻石、<money_space> 每 2 枚 1 钻石（食物与钱币合计最多 5 个）、已建 <settlement> 可见的空凹槽钻石、<storage_area> 钻石（每列行 1-2 间最多 1 个、行 2-3 间最多 2 个，上下两格均存放材料时激活）。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each active diamond, on the <score_track>. Active diamonds are on the left half of your <console> — <food_space>: 1 diamond per 3 markers, <money_space>: 1 diamond per 2 markers (food and money combined at most 5), visible recess diamonds of built <settlement>s, <storage_area> diamonds (per column at most 1 between rows 1-2 and at most 2 between rows 2-3, active when both flanking spaces hold material).

options.step: 本玩家活跃钻石数 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个在 <continent> 上的 <tribe>，得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each of your <tribe>s on the <continent>, on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家 <tribe> 总数 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

description.zh: 每有 1 个有至少 1 个 <tribe> 的区域，得当前时代计分板块显示的分数（每个分值），计入 <score_track>。
description.en: Gain the value shown on the current era's scoring tile for each territory holding at least 1 of your <tribe>s, on the <score_track>.

options.step: 本玩家有部落的区域数 × 当前时代计分板块显示的每个分值

<ontology::condition>.zh: 匹配依据：当前时代计分板块（<era_scoring_area> 最左非空格 <scoring_tile>）显示的类别——板块类别与哪个候选的计分类别一致，就执行该候选（9 个候选分别对应技术/声望/知识/建造/文化进程轨、进化、繁荣、人口、扩张）。
<ontology::condition>.en: Matching basis: the category shown on the current era's scoring tile (the leftmost non-empty space of <era_scoring_area>) — the candidate whose scoring category matches the tile's category executes (the 9 candidates are Technology/Prestige/Knowledge/Construction/Culture tracks, Evolution, Prosperity, Population, Expansion).

description.zh: 所有玩家计分完成后，将当前时代的 <scoring_tile> 从 <era_scoring_area> 的计分格移除并放回 <ontology::game_box>。
description.en: After all players have scored, remove the current era's <scoring_tile> from its space in the <era_scoring_area> and return it to the <ontology::game_box>.

description.zh: D 步：确定新的起始玩家——<starting_monolith> 交给刚在<event_era_scoring>类别中得分最高的玩家。
description.en: Step D: determine the new starting player — the <starting_monolith> goes to the player who just scored the most in that era category.

description.zh: 将 <ontology::starting_player> 设为刚在该类别计分中得分最高的玩家。平局（即使均为 0 分）时，起始玩家资格从现任起始玩家起按座次顺序传给下一个达到最高分的平局玩家。
description.en: Set <ontology::starting_player> to the player who just scored the most points in that category. On a tie (even at 0), the starting player status passes from the outgoing starting player, in seating order, to the next tied player who also scored the most.

<ontology::state_change>.subject: <ontology::starting_player>
<ontology::state_change>.to: 刚在该类别计分中得分最高的玩家（平局：从现任起始玩家起座次顺序中下一个平局者）

description.zh: 新起始玩家获得 <starting_monolith>。
description.en: The new starting player receives the <starting_monolith>.

description.zh: 阶段八：收入阶段。依次执行：A) 获得收入（每位玩家执行每个 <income_chip> 一次，顺序自选）；B) <score_statues>（每座 <statue> 按 <favor_of_ager_track> 上<favor_marker>上方印的分数得分）；C) 回收 <continent> 上所有 <hunting_token> 至 <hunting_token_display>；D) 每位玩家从<ontology::supply>补满空的 <reset_column>。收尾（MATCH）：前三时代（<era_scoring_area>还有板块）将 <phase_indicator> 移回<phase_1_new_cards>开启新时代；第四时代（<era_scoring_area>全空）跳过 C/D，将 <phase_indicator> 放到 <final_scoring_area_hex> 最左六角格，进入<final_scoring>。
description.en: Phase 8: Income Phase. Execute in order: A) Gain income (each player performs each <income_chip> once, order of choice); B) Score statues (each <statue> scores the points printed above your disc on the <favor_of_ager_track>); C) Return all <hunting_token>s from the <continent> to the <hunting_token_display>; D) Each player refills empty <reset_column>s from supply. Ending (MATCH): in eras 1-3 (era scoring area still holds tiles) move the <phase_indicator> back to Phase 1 for the next era; in the 4th era (era scoring area empty) skip C/D and place the <phase_indicator> on the leftmost hexagon of the <final_scoring_area_hex>, entering final scoring.

description.zh: 按座次顺位（从起始玩家开始顺时针）逐一进行收入轮——每位玩家在自己的回合获得收入：对 target（本玩家的全部已安装<income_chip>）各执行一次 <activate_income_chip>，对各芯片的执行顺序自选。
description.en: In seating order (starting player, then clockwise), each player takes an income turn — on their turn they gain income: perform <activate_income_chip> once for each chip of the target (all of the player's installed income chips), across chips in an order of their choice.

<activate_income_chip>.target: 本玩家的全部已安装 <income_chip>（含塞入收入区的初始芯片牌）

description.zh: 本玩家每有 1 座在 <continent> 上的 <statue>，得 <favor_of_ager_track> 上自己<favor_marker>上方印的分数，计入 <score_track>。
description.en: For each of your <statue>s on the <continent>, gain the points printed above your disc on the <favor_of_ager_track>, on the <score_track>.

<ontology::push_track>.step: 本玩家雕像数 × 恩惠轨自己圆盘上方印的分数

description.zh: 将 <continent> 上所有 <hunting_token> 移回 <hunting_token_display>（不要移走<encampment>上的阻挡标记）。第四时代跳过本步。
description.en: Remove all <hunting_token>s from the <continent> and return them to the <hunting_token_display> (do not remove blocking tokens from encampments). Skipped in the 4th era.

<ontology::condition>.zh: <era_scoring_area> 还有计分板块（非第四时代）。
<ontology::condition>.en: The <era_scoring_area> still has scoring tiles (not the 4th era).

<ontology::transfer>.quantity: 全部（营地阻挡标记除外）

description.zh: 每位玩家从自己的<ontology::supply>为每个空的 <reset_column> 补 1 个 <reset_marker>。第四时代跳过本步。
description.en: Each player refills each empty <reset_column> with 1 <reset_marker> from their supply. Skipped in the 4th era.

<ontology::condition>.zh: <era_scoring_area> 还有计分板块（非第四时代）。
<ontology::condition>.en: The <era_scoring_area> still has scoring tiles (not the 4th era).

description.zh: 每个空的 <reset_column> 从玩家供应堆补 1 个 <reset_marker>。
description.en: Refill each empty <reset_column> with 1 <reset_marker> from the player's supply.

description.zh: 时代收尾：前三时代将 <phase_indicator> 移回<phase_1_new_cards>开启新时代；第四时代将 <phase_indicator> 放到 <final_scoring_area_hex> 最左六角格，进入<final_scoring>。
description.en: Era ending: in eras 1-3 return the <phase_indicator> to Phase 1 to start the next era; in the 4th era place the <phase_indicator> on the leftmost hexagon of the <final_scoring_area_hex> to enter final scoring.

description.zh: 时代结束，将 <phase_indicator> 移回 <phase_sequence> 的阶段一（<phase_1_new_cards>），开始新时代。
description.en: The era ends: move the <phase_indicator> back to Phase 1 (<phase_1_new_cards>) of the <phase_sequence> to start the next era.

description.zh: 第四时代结束：将 <phase_indicator> 放到 <final_scoring_area_hex> 的科技格（<final_scoring_area_hex.technology>，最左格），随后进行终局计分。
description.en: The 4th era ends: place the <phase_indicator> on the Technology cell (<final_scoring_area_hex.technology>, the leftmost cell) of the <final_scoring_area_hex>; final scoring follows.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 匹配依据：<era_scoring_area> 是否还有计分板块——还有板块 = 前三时代（回阶段一）；全空 = 第四时代（进入终局计分）。
<ontology::condition>.en: Matching basis: whether the <era_scoring_area> still has scoring tiles — tiles remain = eras 1-3 (return to Phase 1); empty = 4th era (enter final scoring).

description.zh: 终局计分阶段。第四时代<phase_8_income>执行完 A（收入）和 B（<score_statues>）后，跳过 C 和 D，将<phase_indicator>放到<final_scoring_area_hex>起点（科技格），沿轨逐格推进——每格自带效果（见 <final_scoring_area_hex> slots），推进到哪格即结算哪格：9 个类别格各结算对应计分类别、控制台 A 格结算<stage_partition>、控制台 B 格结算 point bonus 卡。走完全轨后比较总分，最高者获胜。
description.en: Final scoring phase. After the 4th era's Income phase steps A (income) and B (statue scoring), skip C and D. Place the phase indicator on the start of the final scoring track (the Technology cell) and advance cell by cell — each cell carries its own effect (see the <final_scoring_area_hex> slots): the 9 category cells score their categories, the Console A cell scores the stage partition, the Console B cell scores point bonus cards. After the whole track, compare totals; the highest wins.

description.zh: 沿 <final_scoring_area_hex> 逐格推进 <phase_indicator>（科技→声望→知识→建设→文化→进化→繁荣→人口→扩张→控制台 A→控制台 B，共 11 格），每推进一格即结算该格的 slot 效果。
description.en: Advance the <phase_indicator> cell by cell along the <final_scoring_area_hex> (Technology→Prestige→Knowledge→Construction→Culture→Evolution→Prosperity→Population→Expansion→Console A→Console B, 11 cells); each cell's slot effect resolves as it is reached.

description.zh: 将 <phase_indicator> 沿 <final_scoring_area_hex> 推进到下一格——该格 slot 的效果自动结算（类别格按该格下方印的分值/被 <scoring_tile> 覆盖时的板块分数计分）。
description.en: Advance the <phase_indicator> to the next cell of the <final_scoring_area_hex> — that cell's slot effect resolves automatically (category cells score by the printed value below the cell, or the covering <scoring_tile>'s points).

result.en: The score resolved at the current cell.

description.zh: 逐级比较判定胜者：先比<success_point>，并列者再比<upgrade_main_module>数，仍并列者比座次顺序——每一级若分出唯一胜者即结束，否则进入下一级。
description.en: Adjudicate the winner level by level: compare success points first; tied players compare module upgrades; still tied players compare seating order — each level ends the adjudication if it yields a unique winner, otherwise the next level applies.

description.zh: 比较所有玩家的<success_point>，最高者获胜（唯一时判定结束）。
description.en: Compare all players' success points; the highest wins (adjudication ends if unique).

result.zh: 成功点数最高的玩家；若并列则并列者进入下一级。
result.en: The player(s) with the highest success points; ties advance to the next level.

description.zh: <success_point>并列的玩家中，已执行更多<upgrade_main_module>者获胜（唯一时判定结束）。
description.en: Among the tied players, the one with more module upgrades wins (adjudication ends if unique).

description.zh: 成功点数最高的玩家不唯一（存在并列）。
description.en: The player(s) with the highest success points are not unique (a tie exists).

result.zh: 升级数最多的平局玩家；仍并列则进入下一级。
result.en: The tied player(s) with the most module upgrades; further ties advance to the next level.

description.zh: 仍并列的玩家按座次顺序（从起始玩家顺时针）先到者获胜。
description.en: Among the still-tied players, the one earliest in seating order (clockwise from the starting player) wins.

description.zh: 模组升级数最多的平局玩家不唯一（仍存在并列）。
description.en: The tied player(s) with the most module upgrades are not unique (still tied).

result.zh: 座次最前的平局玩家（必为唯一胜者）。
result.en: The tied player earliest in seating order (always a unique winner).

description.zh: 每当某玩家的 <score_marker> 在 <score_track> 上越过 99 格（跨过循环边界）时，该玩家从 <hundred_point_token_display> 拿取 1 个 <hundred_point_token> 放在<console>旁（实际总分 = 指示物数 × 100 + <score_marker>位置）。
description.en: Whenever a player's <score_marker> crosses space 99 on the <score_track> (across the loop boundary), that player takes 1 <hundred_point_token> from the <hundred_point_token_display> and places it next to their console (actual total = tokens × 100 + disc position).

description.zh: 从 <hundred_point_token_display> 拿取 1 个 <hundred_point_token> 放到该玩家控制台旁。
description.en: Take 1 <hundred_point_token> from the <hundred_point_token_display> and place it next to that player's console.

description.zh: 进程轨奖励线（印在轨上的奖励阈值）的接口概念：每条奖励线是一个 <track_bonus> 实例，声明自己的触发格（trigger_slot）与奖励效果（<ontology::content>）。共 4 种奖励类型：① <upgrade_main_module>（模组两个<activation_die>费用点数之一与本轨 bonus_die_value 一致即可选择，见 <technology_track>.bonus_die_value 等路径）；② <favor_of_ager_track>推进 1 格或执行 1 个<income_chip>效果（二选一）；③ 翻 1 个<stage_tile>到激活面或得 3 分（二选一）；④ 得 3 分。
description.en: Interface concept for the progress-track bonus lines (bonus thresholds printed on the tracks): each bonus line is a <track_bonus> instance declaring its trigger space (trigger_slot) and bonus effect (<ontology::content>). Four bonus types: ① upgrade 1 main module (selectable if one of its two activation die cost values matches this track's bonus_die_value, see paths like <technology_track>.bonus_die_value); ② advance the Favor of Agera track 1 step OR perform 1 income chip action; ③ flip 1 stage tile to active OR gain 3 success points; ④ gain 3 success points.

description.zh: 本奖励线的触发格（可多个）：进程轨上的路径式格引用，如 <progress_track>.progress_space[1]（5 轨同布局，引用接口概念 <progress_track> 即覆盖全部 5 轨）。被 <ontology::condition> 引用——越过其中任一格即触发。
description.en: This bonus line's trigger spaces (may be multiple): path-style space references on a progress track, e.g. <progress_track>.progress_space[1] (all five tracks share the layout, so referencing the interface concept <progress_track> covers all of them). Referenced by <ontology::condition> — crossing any of them triggers.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本玩家的 <progress_marker> 越过 this.trigger_slot 声明的任一奖励线格。
<ontology::condition>.en: A player's <progress_marker> crosses any bonus-line space declared by this.trigger_slot.

description.zh: 本奖励线的触发格（可多个：路径式格引用数组，被 <ontology::condition> 引用）。
description.en: This bonus line's trigger spaces (may be multiple: array of path-style references, referenced by <ontology::condition>).

description.zh: 触发后获得的奖励效果。
description.en: The bonus effect gained on trigger.

description.zh: <upgrade_main_module>：该模组的两个<activation_die>费用点数之一与推进的轨道对应的<activation_die>点数一致即可升级。
description.en: Upgrade 1 main module: a module is upgradable if one of its two activation die cost values matches the advanced track's activation die value.

description.zh: 1 个费用包含推进的轨道<activation_die>点数（bonus_die_value）的主模组，该模组两个<activation_die>费用点数之一与推进轨的 bonus_die_value 一致即可选择。
description.en: Upgrade 1 main module whose cost includes the advanced track's activation die value (bonus_die_value): selectable if one of the module's two activation die cost values matches the advanced track's bonus_die_value (see paths like <technology_track>.bonus_die_value).

description.zh: 将<favor_of_ager_track>推进 1 格，或选择 1 个已安装的<income_chip>执行其效果（二选一）。
description.en: Advance the Favor of Agera track 1 step, or choose 1 installed income chip and perform its action (choose one).

description.zh: 翻 1 个未激活的<stage_tile>到激活面，或得 3 分（二选一）。
description.en: Flip 1 inactive stage tile to its active side, or gain 3 success points (choose one).

description.zh: 得 3 分。
description.en: Gain 3 success points.

description.zh: <progress_marker>无法推进超过<progress_track>的“12”格。如果你的<progress_marker>已经位于<progress_track>的“12”格，你将要在该轨道推进的每一步，都改为获得 2 分。
description.en: You can't advance beyond space 12 on any progress track. If your disc is already on space 12 of a track, gain 2 success points for every additional step you would gain there.

<ontology::push_track>.step: 超出终点 12 的步数，每步 2 分

description.zh: <score_marker>反向越过 0 格（跨过循环边界）时：失去 1 个 <hundred_point_token>（放回 <hundred_point_token_display>）；回绕后按步数继续移动（环形轨自然语义）。
description.en: When the score marker crosses space 0 in reverse (across the loop boundary): lose 1 <hundred_point_token> (return it to the <hundred_point_token_display>); after wrapping, it keeps moving for the remaining steps (the circular track's natural semantics).

description.zh: 每位玩家的标记供应堆上限 50 个 <octagonal_pillar>。当玩家需要从自己的<ontology::supply>拿取标记但供应堆已空时，可立即回收 <console> 或 <continent> 上的任意数量标记退回<ontology::supply>以补充——<statue>、<reset_marker> 和<boat>上的标记除外。
description.en: Each player's marker supply holds up to 50 <octagonal_pillar>s. When a player needs to take markers from their supply but it is empty, they may immediately return any number of markers from the <console> or <continent> to replenish it — except <statue>s, <reset_marker>s, and markers on <boat>s.

description.zh: 某玩家需要从自己的标记供应堆拿取标记，但供应堆已空。
description.en: A player needs to take markers from their supply, but the supply is empty.

description.zh: 不回收（跳过）
description.en: Skip (do not replenish)

description.zh: 从 <console> 或 <continent> 上回收任意数量的标记退回该玩家的供应堆（雕像、重置标记与船上的标记除外）。
description.en: Return any number of markers from the <console> or <continent> to the player's supply (except <statue>s, <reset_marker>s, and markers on <boat>s).

<ontology::transfer>.source: <console> 上除 <reset_marker> 以外的 <octagonal_pillar>，或 <continent> 上的 <octagonal_pillar>
<ontology::transfer>.quantity: 任意数量（雕像、重置标记、船上的标记除外）

description.zh: 投掷全部 <fate_die>，可消耗<idea_marker>调整骰子点数（1 和 6 相连），只要有一颗点数落在 [1, <favor_of_ager_track>.position] 闭区间内即为通过。
description.en: Roll all <fate_die>s; <idea_marker>s may adjust the values (1 and 6 are adjacent). Pass if any die value falls within the closed interval [1, <favor_of_ager_track>.position].

description.zh: 投掷玩家持有的全部 <fate_die>。
description.en: Roll all <fate_die> held by the player.

description.zh: 可选：询问是否消耗<idea_marker>修改任意一颗<fate_die>的点数（每 1 个 = ±1，1 和 6 相连）。
description.en: Optional: ask whether to spend <idea_marker>s to modify any <fate_die>'s value (each = ±1, 1 and 6 are adjacent).

description.zh: 不调整（跳过）
description.en: Skip (do not adjust)

description.zh: 支付任意数量（N）的<idea_marker>（从<idea_space>返还<ontology::supply>，每 1 个 = ±1 点），将 1 颗自己持有的<activation_die>或<fate_die>的点数加/减 N（1 和 6 相连——一个标记即可在 1 与 6 之间互改）。只能调整骰子，不能调整<planning_marker>。
description.en: Spend any number (N) of <idea_marker>s (returned from <idea_space> to <ontology::supply>, each worth ±1) to increase or decrease the value of 1 <activation_die> or <fate_die> you hold by N (1 and 6 are adjacent — one marker converts a 1 to a 6 or vice versa). Only dice can be adjusted, not <planning_marker>s.

<ontology::condition>.zh: <idea_space> 中至少有 1 个 <idea_marker>。
<ontology::condition>.en: At least 1 <idea_marker> in <idea_space>.

triggers.target: 1 颗自己持有的<activation_die>或<fate_die>

description.zh: 每支付 1 个创意标记，骰子点数 ±1；支付 N 个则 ±N。
description.en: Each idea marker spent changes the die value by ±1; spending N changes it by ±N.

description.zh: 从<console>的<stage_partition>中选择 1 个已安装的 <income_chip>，激活其 <ontology::effect>。<starting_chip_card>塞入<income_area>后（其上三分之一的 <income_chip> 露出）也可被选择。
description.en: Choose 1 installed <income_chip> from the console stage partition and activate its <ontology::effect>. A starting chip card slid into the income area (its top-third <income_chip> revealed) may also be chosen.

triggers.target: 1 个已安装的 <income_chip>

description.zh: 选择 1 个可用的 <activity> 并激活。
description.en: Choose 1 available <activity> and activate it.

triggers.target: 1 个可用的 <activity>

description.zh: 将手牌中的一张 <research_card> 投入使用：确定列与层级 → 满足 <cost_space> 费用格（可 assume a higher stage 多满足至更高层）→ 结算 <success_point>（已满足<cost_space>下方印的分之和）→ 结算 <instant_bonus>（可放弃）→ 插入（仅上三分之一露出，<research_ability> 激活持续可用）。
description.en: Put a <research_card> from hand into use: determine column and tier → fulfill the <cost_space>s (may assume a higher stage) → resolve <success_point> (sum of the fulfilled cost spaces' printed scores) → resolve <instant_bonus> (may forgo) → insert (only the top third remains visible; the <research_ability> activates and stays usable).

description.zh: 确定费用范围：所选 <research_card> 的 parts.<cost_space> 共 5 格费用格。N 为安装层级，至少满足前 N 格中所有非空格（即 active cost spaces）；可自愿承担更高层费用（assume a higher stage），最多满足至第 M 格（N ≤ M ≤ 5），前缀连续覆盖——每多满足一格，获得该格下方印的 <success_point>。
description.en: Determine the cost range: the chosen <research_card>'s parts.<cost_space> provides 5 cost spaces. N is the install tier — fulfill at least all non-empty spaces in the first N (the active cost spaces); you may voluntarily assume a higher stage, fulfilling up to space M (N ≤ M ≤ 5) as a contiguous prefix — each extra fulfilled space grants the <success_point> printed below it.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 已安装同类型研究牌。
<ontology::condition>.en: A same-type research card is already installed.

description.zh: 选该列最低空位（层级序号即<cost_space> N）。
description.en: Use the lowest empty slot of that column (tier index = the cost spaces' N).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 尚未安装同类型研究牌。
<ontology::condition>.en: No same-type research card is installed yet.

description.zh: 任选一个空列，安装在该列最低空位（层级序号即<cost_space> N）。
description.en: Choose any empty column, install at the lowest empty slot of that column (tier index = the cost spaces' N).

description.zh: 选一个仅含 <income_chip> 的列，安装在该列最低空位。
description.en: Choose a column containing only <income_chip>s, install at the lowest empty slot of that column.

description.zh: 放弃（不能或不想执行则作废）
description.en: Forgo (forfeit if unable or unwilling)

description.zh: 本卡 <research_ability> 自此激活、持续可用。
description.en: The card's <research_ability> is active from now on.

description.zh: 将选中的 <starting_chip_card> 塞入 <console> 的<income_area>，成为玩家的首个<income_chip>（其 <income_chip> 部分在<activate_income_chip>时可选）。无<cost_space>（区别于<install_research_card>）。
description.en: Slide the chosen <starting_chip_card> into the <console>'s income area as the player's first income chip (its <income_chip> part is selectable when activating income chips). No cost slots (unlike installing research cards).

description.zh: 将一枚 <goal_chip> 从<goal_area>安装到<stage_partition>。翻至背面，选左/右半侧，安装至最低空位。
description.en: Install a <goal_chip> from the goal area into the stage partition. Flip to back, choose left/right half, place at lowest empty position.

description.zh: 将一枚 <income_chip> 安装到 <stage_partition>。任选一列，安装至最低空闲 <tier>。
description.en: Install an <income_chip> into the <stage_partition>. Choose any column, install at lowest empty <tier>.

description.zh: 将一枚 <attribute_chip> 安装到 <stage_partition>。若已有同列则继续该列，否则任选空列。
description.en: Install an <attribute_chip> into the <stage_partition>. Continue existing column or choose any empty one.

description.zh: 将 1 个 <food> 从 <food_space> 返回<ontology::supply>。
description.en: Return 1 <food> from <food_space> to the supply.

description.zh: 将 1 个 <tribe> 从 <continent> 返回玩家<ontology::supply>。
description.en: Return 1 <tribe> from the <continent> to the player's supply.

description.zh: 从 5 条<progress_track>中任选 1 条推进。
description.en: Choose any 1 of the 5 progress tracks and advance on it.

description.zh: <phase_7_event> A 步（<adjust_weather_indicator>）执行完毕后，按 <weather_indicator> 所在格结算天气效果，所有玩家按座次顺位逐一结算。正面效果可放弃，负面效果必须执行。
description.en: After step A of the Event phase (<adjust_weather_indicator>) completes, the weather effect of the slot the <weather_indicator> is on is resolved by all players in seating order. Positive effects may be forgone; negative effects are mandatory.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 事件阶段（Phase 7）A 步——<adjust_weather_indicator> 移动 <weather_indicator> 的步骤——执行完毕（触发点仅此一次：本 trigger 由该步骤完成激活，结算标记所在格的效果；越线格效果内的推回极端格移动不构成触发）
<ontology::condition>.en: Step A of the Event phase (Phase 7) — the <adjust_weather_indicator> step that moves the <weather_indicator> — has completed (fired exactly once: this trigger activates at that step's completion and resolves the effect of the slot the indicator is on; the push-back movement inside an over-line slot's effect does not trigger it)

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 按座次顺位，每位玩家逐一结算 <weather_indicator> 所在 <weather_gauge> 格的效果（见其 slots 定义）：正面效果可选择放弃，负面效果必须执行；既无 <food> 也无 <tribe> 的玩家不受影响。越线格（<weather_gauge.hot_beyond>/<weather_gauge.cold_beyond>）效果内的推回极端格步骤属该格效果的一部分，不再次触发本结算。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: In seating order, each player resolves the effect of the <weather_gauge> slot the <weather_indicator> is on (see its slots): positive effects may be forgone; negative effects are mandatory; a player with neither <food> nor <tribe> is unaffected. The push-back-to-extreme-space step inside an over-line slot's (<weather_gauge.hot_beyond>/<weather_gauge.cold_beyond>) effect is part of that effect and does not re-trigger this resolution.

description.zh: 对 1 个未达最高等级的<upgradable_module>执行 1 次<ontology::upgrade>（<ontology::state_change>：level 属性提升 1 级）。物理后果：L1→L2 <module>的<ontology::tile>翻面，L2→L3 <module>的<ontology::tile>放回<ontology::game_box>、<console>上 L3 效果激活。
description.en: Perform 1 <ontology::upgrade> on a main module not at max level (<ontology::state_change>: level attribute increases by 1). Physical consequences: L1→L2 flips the module tile; L2→L3 returns the tile to the <ontology::game_box> and activates the console L3 effect.

description.zh: 选择一个未达等级三的<upgradable_module>。
description.en: Choose a main module not yet at level 3.

description.zh: <module> level 属性从 1 变为 2。物理后果：将<module>的<ontology::tile>翻至等级二面（该等级 effect 由<ontology::tile>反面承载）。
description.en: Module level attribute changes from 1 to 2. Physical consequence: flip the module tile to its level-2 side (that level's effect is carried by the tile back).

description.zh: <module> level 属性从 2 变为 3。物理后果：将<module>的<ontology::tile>放回 <ontology::game_box>，<console>的<module_area>底部的 L3 effect 激活。
description.en: Module level attribute changes from 2 to 3. Physical consequence: return the module tile to <ontology::game_box>; the L3 effect printed at the console module slot becomes active.

description.zh: 获得 1 个<income_chip>并触发其效果。
description.en: Gain 1 income chip and trigger its effect.

description.zh: 将 1 个健康的<tribe>从一个<territory>移动至相邻<territory>。同一<territory>内不能移动；不能进入<site>。分属两块<continent_tile>的同一地形类型<territory>（即使地形一样）视为两个不同<territory>——只要彼此接壤即可。山脉<territory>规则上与其他<territory>完全一样。
description.en: Move 1 healthy tribe from one territory to an adjacent territory. Cannot move within the same territory; cannot enter <site>s. Territories of the same terrain type on different continent tiles (even if the terrain is identical) are separate territories — valid as long as their borders touch. Mountain territories function identically to all other types.

triggers.target: 1 个 posture == <upright> 的 <tribe> + 1 个相邻领地的营地（陆地），或 1 个自己的位于相邻水流区域且有空位的 <boat>。

description.zh: <migrate>后的自动触发结算。各 trigger 按自身 condition 独立判定，满足即执行。
description.en: Automatic trigger resolution after migration. Each trigger independently checks its condition and fires if met.

description.zh: 执行迁徙的 <tribe>。
description.en: The <tribe> that performed the migration.

description.zh: 部落移动到的目标领地。
description.en: The destination territory the tribe moved to.

description.zh: 将占据<encampment>的<tribe>移至同一<territory>的野外（保留其站立/躺倒状态）。
description.en: Move the occupying tribe to the wilderness of the same territory (retaining its upright/lying state).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 目的地为陆地营地，且该营地已被其他<tribe>占据（无论自己或他人）。
<ontology::condition>.en: Destination is a land encampment occupied by another <tribe> (own or opponent's).

description.zh: <tribe>落定于<fire_encampment>时立即获得营地所示分数。
description.en: Gain the points shown on the fire encampment immediately when the migrating tribe settles there.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 目的地营地是篝火营地（黄色边框）。
<ontology::condition>.en: The destination encampment is a fire encampment (yellow border).

description.zh: 驱赶其他<tribe>后，迁徙<tribe>变虚弱。
description.en: Migrating tribe becomes weak after displacing another tribe.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 目的地不是水流区域，且该区域<material_tile>背面朝上（此前无部落驻足）。
<ontology::condition>.en: Destination is not a Water territory, and its <material_tile> is face-down (no tribe has ever settled here).

description.zh: 从<ontology::supply>取 1 个<octagonal_pillar>放至目标<territory>作为<raw_material>。
description.en: Place 1 octagonal pillar from supply onto the destination territory as a raw material marker.

description.zh: 1 次迁徙：将<tribe>移动到相邻<territory>，随后玩家决定是落定还是继续旅程——落定则结算<resolve_migration_triggers>；继续旅程（该<tribe>本激活内将再次迁徙）则为穿越，不结算触发、不进入<encampment>、不获得<fire_encampment>分、不开发<territory>。
description.en: 1 migration: move the tribe to an adjacent territory, then the player decides whether to settle or continue the journey — settling resolves migration triggers; continuing (the same tribe will migrate again this activation) crosses through: no trigger resolution, no encampment entry, no fire encampment points, no territory development.

triggers.target: this.target

description.zh: 继续旅程（穿越）：该部落本激活内将再次迁徙，本次不结算迁徙触发。
description.en: Continue the journey (cross through): this tribe will migrate again this activation; skip trigger resolution.

description.zh: 获得 1 张<research_card>：选择一种<research_card>类型（建造/洞悉/突变/成就/发明），从该类型的<face_up_research_stack>顶或<research_deck>顶拿取 1 张<research_card>至手牌。拿取后若正面堆为空，自动从对应<research_deck>翻一张补充。
description.en: Gain 1 research card: Choose a card type (Building/Insight/Mutation/Achievement/Invention), take the top <research_card> from that type's <face_up_research_stack> or <research_deck> to hand. If the face-up stack becomes empty, auto-refill from the corresponding face-down deck.

description.zh: 从选定类型的正面朝上堆顶拿取 1 张<research_card>。
description.en: Take the top <research_card> from the chosen type's face-up stack.

description.zh: 从选定类型的背面朝下堆顶盲抽 1 张<research_card>（顶牌未知）。
description.en: Blindly draw the top <research_card> from the chosen type's face-down deck (the top card is unseen).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 任意<face_up_research_stack>为空
<ontology::condition>.en: Any <face_up_research_stack> is empty

description.zh: 从对应背面朝下堆翻一张补充到正面朝上堆。
description.en: Refill the face-up stack from the corresponding face-down deck.

description.zh: 从<research_deck>抽 N 张牌检视，选 K 张转入<player_holding>，其余放回各自来源牌堆底部。N 和 K 由调用方指定。
description.en: Draw N cards from face-down research decks, inspect them, pick K to transfer to <player_holding>, and return the rest face-down to the bottom of their respective source decks. N and K are specified by the caller.

description.zh: 抽取的研究牌数量（N）。
description.en: Number of research cards drawn (N).

description.zh: 选入<player_holding>的研究牌数量（K）。
description.en: Number of research cards picked to <player_holding> (K).

description.zh: 从任意<research_deck>（可同堆或不同堆）共抽 N 张<research_card>检视。
description.en: Draw N <research_card>s total from any <research_deck>s (same or different) and inspect them.

description.zh: 从抽出的 N 张中选 K 张<research_card>加入手牌。
description.en: Pick K <research_card>s from the drawn cards and add to hand.

description.zh: 将未选中的<research_card>面朝下放回各自来源牌堆底部。
description.en: Return the unpicked <research_card>s face-down to the bottom of their respective source decks.

description.zh: 交易行动。出售<storage_area>的<stored_material>换取<money>或分数，或用<money>购买新<stored_material>。必须从出售与购买中至少选择一项执行（可只卖、只买，顺序任意）：
description.en: The Trade action. Sell stored materials for money or points, or purchase new materials with money. At least one of Sale or Purchase must be performed (may sell only or buy only, in any order):

description.zh: 出售：从<storage_area>选最多 2 个<stored_material>，一个可换<money>，一个可换 2 分。二者不可重复。
description.en: Sale: Sell up to 2 materials. One may be for money, one for 2 points. Cannot double up.

description.zh: 换钱币：售出一个<stored_material>换取<money>。
description.en: For money: Sell one material for money.

quantity.zh: 由材料行决定：第一行 1、第二行 2、第三行 3
quantity.en: Determined by material row: row 1 = 1, row 2 = 2, row 3 = 3

description.zh: 换分数：售出一个<stored_material>换取 2 分。
description.en: For points: Sell one material for 2 points.

description.zh: 购买：支付<money>，从<ontology::supply>获取一个<stored_material>标记放入<storage_area>。
description.en: Purchase: Pay money, then take one material marker from supply into storage.

description.zh: 幸运收获：选择一种<territory>类型（该<territory>中至少有一个你的<tribe>），投掷全部<fate_die>，选一颗骰子的点数。根据点数和所选<territory>类型，在<storage_area>对应的连线找到获得的<stored_material>，从<ontology::supply>取一个标记放入对应仓库格。
description.en: Make a lucky find: Choose a territory type where you have at least one tribe, roll all pink fate dice, choose one result. The result combined with the territory type determines the material via connecting lines on the storage area; place a marker from supply onto that storage space.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 至少有一种领地类型拥有至少一个自己的<tribe>。
<ontology::condition>.en: At least one territory type has at least one of your <tribe>s.

triggers.target: 一种至少有一个自己<tribe>的领地类型

description.zh: 投掷全部<fate_die>。玩家可消耗创意标记修改任意骰子点数（1 和 6 相连）。
description.en: Roll all pink fate dice. Player may spend idea markers to change any die value (1 and 6 are adjacent).

description.zh: 根据玩家选择的领地类型和骰子点数，按仓库区连线对应的材料，从供应堆取 1 个标记放入对应仓库格。
description.en: Based on the player's chosen territory type and die result, take 1 marker of the material indicated by the storage area's connecting lines from supply into the matching storage space.

description.zh: 选择 1 个背面朝上的 <site>，将其翻转至正面朝上，立即获得其正面左上角标记的分数（推进 <score_track>），随后结算该<site>的 <ontology::effect>。翻开后<site>保持正面朝上，持续影响相邻<territory>。
description.en: Choose 1 face-down <site>, flip it face up, immediately gain the success points marked in its top-left corner (advance <score_track>), then resolve the site's <ontology::effect>. The site stays face up and affects adjacent territories for the rest of the game.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 存在至少 1 个 face == face_down 的 <site>。
<ontology::condition>.en: At least one <site> with face == face_down exists.

triggers.target: 1 个 face == face_down 的 <site>

description.zh: 选择 1 个有你至少一个<tribe>的<territory>，将与这个<territory>相邻的所有 face == face_down 的 <site> 作为目标，逐一执行<explore_site>。
description.en: Choose 1 territory where you have at least one <tribe>; every <site> with face == face_down adjacent to it becomes a target, and <explore_site> is performed on each.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 存在至少一个区域：有至少一个自己的<tribe>，且相邻至少一个 face == face_down 的 <site>。
<ontology::condition>.en: There exists a territory with at least one of your <tribe>s and at least one adjacent <site> with face == face_down.

triggers.target: 1 个有至少一个自己<tribe>的区域，且其相邻存在 face == face_down 的 <site>

<explore_site>.target: this.target 相邻的所有 face == face_down 的 <site>

description.zh: 选择 1 个有至少一个自己<tribe>的<territory>，从<ontology::supply>取 1 个新<tribe>放到该<territory>的<encampment>；<continent>上没有任何自己的<tribe>时可任选<territory>；<boat>上有空座时也可在<boat>上繁育。若 20 个<tribe>全部在场则不能繁育。
description.en: Choose a territory with at least one of your <tribe>s. Take a new <tribe> from supply and place it onto an encampment in that territory; any territory is allowed if you have no tribes on the continent; procreation on a boat is allowed if it has a free seat. Cannot procreate if all 20 tribes are on the continent.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 场上自己的<tribe>少于 20 个。
<ontology::condition>.en: Fewer than 20 of your <tribe>s are on the continent.

triggers.target: 1 个有至少一个自己<tribe>的区域（大陆无部落时可任选区域；船繁育需船上恰有 1 个部落且另一座空着）及其中的放置营地

description.zh: 从供应堆取 1 个新<tribe>放到目标区域的营地（或船空座）。
description.en: Take 1 new <tribe> from supply and place it on an encampment (or free boat seat) in the target territory.

description.zh: 1 次繁育：从<ontology::supply>取新<tribe>放到目标<territory>的<encampment>（<place_new_tribe>），随后按各自 condition 结算繁育触发——<encampment>被占则驱逐原<tribe>（新<tribe>随之虚弱放下）；<fire_encampment>照常得分；未开发<territory>立即开发。
description.en: 1 procreation: take a new <tribe> from supply onto an encampment in the target territory (<place_new_tribe>), then resolve triggers by their own conditions — displace the occupant if the encampment is occupied (the new tribe is then laid down weakened); fire encampments score as usual; undeveloped territories are developed immediately.

triggers.target: this.target

<ontology::condition>.zh: 放置营地为陆地营地，且已被任意<tribe>占据（无论自己或他人）。
<ontology::condition>.en: The encampment is a land encampment occupied by any <tribe> (own or opponent's).

description.zh: 将占据营地的部落移至同一区域的荒野（保留其站立/躺倒状态）。
description.en: Move the occupying tribe to the wilderness of the same territory (retaining its upright/lying state).

description.zh: 驱逐原部落后，新部落虚弱放下。
description.en: The new tribe is laid down weakened after displacing the occupant.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 放置营地是篝火营地（黄色边框）。
<ontology::condition>.en: The encampment is a fire encampment (yellow border).

description.zh: 获得营地所示分数，推进<score_track>。
description.en: Gain the points depicted on the encampment; advance <score_track>.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 目标区域不是水流区域，且该区域<material_tile>背面朝上（此前无部落驻足）。
<ontology::condition>.en: The territory is not a Water territory, and its <material_tile> is face-down (no tribe has ever settled here).

description.zh: 从<ontology::supply>取 1 个<octagonal_pillar>放至目标<territory>作为<raw_material>。
description.en: Place 1 octagonal pillar from supply onto the target territory as a raw material marker.

description.zh: 选择 1 个有至少一个自己<tribe>且无<hunting_token>的<territory>，掷全部<fate_die>，选 1 个骰子的点数，按<hunting_table>（<territory>类型 × 点数）确定<food>数量，从<ontology::supply>拿对应数量<food>放到<console>的<food_space>（可用<idea_marker>修改骰子点数），最后从<hunting_token_display>取 1 个<hunting_token>放到该<territory>——本时代内任何玩家都不能再在此<territory><hunt>。
description.en: Choose a territory with at least one of your <tribe>s and no <hunting_token>. Roll all pink fate dice, pick one result, and look up the hunting table (territory type × die value) for the food amount. Take that many <food> from supply onto your food space (idea markers may change the die value). Finally place a <hunting_token> from the display onto that territory — no one may hunt there for the rest of the era.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 存在至少一个区域：有至少一个自己的<tribe>，且无<hunting_token>。
<ontology::condition>.en: There exists a territory with at least one of your <tribe>s and no <hunting_token>.

triggers.target: 1 个有至少一个自己<tribe>且无<hunting_token>的区域

description.zh: 掷玩家持有的全部<fate_die>，选 1 个骰子的点数（1 和 6 相连）。
description.en: Roll all <fate_die>s held by the player and choose one result (1 and 6 are adjacent).

description.zh: 可选：询问是否消耗<idea_marker>修改所选骰子的点数（每 1 个 = ±1，1 和 6 相连）。
description.en: Optional: ask whether to spend <idea_marker>s to modify the chosen die's value (each = ±1, 1 and 6 are adjacent).

description.zh: 不调整（跳过）
description.en: Skip (do not adjust)

description.zh: 按狩猎表（区域类型 × 骰子点数）查表确定食物数量，从供应堆拿取对应数量的<octagonal_pillar>放到食物格，成为<food>。
description.en: Look up the hunting table (territory type × die value) for the food amount and take that many <octagonal_pillar>s from supply onto the food space, becoming <food>.

description.zh: 放 1 个<hunting_token>到该区域：本时代内不能再在此狩猎。
description.en: Place 1 <hunting_token> on the territory: it cannot be hunted for the rest of the era.

description.zh: 将任意 1 个虚弱（posture == <lying>）的<tribe>扶起为直立（<upright>）。
description.en: Stand any 1 weak (<lying>) <tribe> up to <upright>.

triggers.target: 1 个 posture == <lying> 的<tribe>

description.zh: 虚弱部落直立。
description.en: The weak tribe stands up.

description.zh: 选择 1 个有至少一个自己<tribe>的<territory>，从<ontology::supply>取 1 个标记放入该<territory>，成为该<territory>的<material_tile>所示类型的<raw_material>。<boat>上有至少一个<tribe>且中央凹槽未被占用时也可在<boat>上生产（材料类型到<transport_material>时才确定）。<raw_material>本身没有价值也不能使用，只有运输到<storage_area>后才成为可用的<stored_material>（可用于建造或支付卡牌费用）。
description.en: Choose a territory with at least one of your <tribe>s and place a marker from supply into it, representing a raw material of the type shown on the territory's material tile. Production on a boat is possible with at least one tribe aboard and the central notch free (type determined at transport time). Raw materials have no value by themselves and cannot be used; only after being transported to storage do they become usable <stored_material>s (e.g., for building or paying card costs).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 存在区域（或有自己的船）：有至少一个自己的<tribe>；船上生产需中央凹槽未被占用。
<ontology::condition>.en: There exists a territory (or one of your boats) with at least one of your <tribe>s; boat production requires a free central notch.

triggers.target: 1 个有至少一个自己<tribe>的区域（或自己的船）

description.zh: 从供应堆取 1 个标记放入目标区域，成为原材料。
description.en: Place 1 marker from supply into the target territory as a raw material.

description.zh: 选择<continent>上任意 1 个自己的陆地<raw_material>标记（无需该<territory>有<tribe>），按所在<territory>的<material_tile>的材料类型，将标记放到对应材料类型的<storage_area>格，成为<stored_material>。
description.en: Choose any 1 of your raw material markers on the continent (no tribe required in that territory). Move the marker to the storage space matching its territory's <material_tile> material type, becoming a <stored_material>.

triggers.target: 大陆上任意 1 个自己的陆地原材料标记（<octagonal_pillar>）

description.zh: 按该区域<material_tile>的材料类型，将标记放到对应仓库格。
description.en: Move the marker to the storage space matching the territory's <material_tile> type.

description.zh: 选择 1 个自己的<boat>载<raw_material>标记，运输到<storage_area>格。默认按<boat>所在水流<territory>相邻的已开发<territory>（任选其一）的<stored_material>类型确定<storage_area>格；调用方可传 storage_space = 'any' 放宽为任意<storage_area>格（<transport_material> L3）。
description.en: Choose 1 of your raw material markers on a boat and transport it to a storage space. By default the storage space matches the material type of a developed territory adjacent to the boat's Water territory (choose one); the caller may pass storage_space = 'any' to allow any storage space (Transport module L3).

triggers.target: 1 个自己的船载原材料标记（<octagonal_pillar>）

description.zh: 仓库格选择规则。缺省 = 按船所在水流区域相邻的已开发区域（任选其一）的材料类型；'any' = 任意仓库格（运输模组 L3 放宽）。
description.en: Storage space selection rule. Default = material type of a developed territory adjacent to the boat's Water territory (choose one); 'any' = any storage space (Transport module L3 relaxation).

description.zh: 将标记从船移到仓库格。默认按相邻已开发区域的类型确定格位；storage_space = 'any' 时可放入任意仓库格。
description.en: Move the marker from the boat to a storage space. By default the space matches an adjacent developed territory's type; with storage_space = 'any' any space is allowed.

description.zh: 运输 1 个<raw_material>到<storage_area>：陆地<raw_material>按所在<territory>类型（<transport_land_material>）；<boat>载<raw_material>按相邻已开发<territory>类型或调用方指定规则（<transport_boat_material>）。
description.en: Transport 1 raw material to storage: land raw material by its territory's type (<transport_land_material>); boat raw material by an adjacent developed territory's type or a caller-specified rule (<transport_boat_material>).

description.zh: 获得 1 个<activation_die>：优先从<dice_display>拿取；<dice_display>无骰子时从拥有<activation_die>最多的玩家处拿取。拿到后立即投掷一次，按点数放到<console>的<activation_dice_area>对应点数格上。
description.en: Gain 1 <activation_die>: take it from the dice display if available; otherwise take it from a civilization with the most activation dice. Roll it immediately and place it on the matching dice space of your console.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 骰子展示区有<activation_die>。
<ontology::condition>.en: The dice display has an <activation_die>.

description.zh: 从展示区拿取 1 枚<activation_die>。
description.en: Take 1 activation die from the display.

description.zh: 投掷该<activation_die>一次，确定点数。
description.en: Roll the activation die once to determine its value.

description.zh: 按掷出的点数将该<activation_die>放入控制台对应点数的骰子格。
description.en: Place the activation die on the dice space of the console matching the rolled value.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 骰子展示区没有<activation_die>，且自己不是唯一拥有<activation_die>数量最多的玩家。
<ontology::condition>.en: The dice display has no <activation_die>, and you are not the only player with the most activation dice.

options.target: 除自己之外的 1 个 <ontology::player>（拥有<activation_die>数量最多的玩家；多人并列最多时由该玩家决定给出哪颗）

description.zh: 从拥有<activation_die>最多的玩家处拿取 1 枚<activation_die>。
description.en: Take 1 activation die from the civilization with the most.

description.zh: 投掷该<activation_die>一次，确定点数。
description.en: Roll the activation die once to determine its value.

description.zh: 按掷出的点数将该<activation_die>放入控制台对应点数的骰子格。
description.en: Place the activation die on the dice space of the console matching the rolled value.

description.zh: 获得 1 个<fate_die>：优先从<dice_display>拿取；<dice_display>无骰子时从拥有<fate_die>最多的玩家处拿取。加入自己持有的<fate_die>（之后<favor_test>、<hunt>、<lucky_find>时一起掷）。
description.en: Gain 1 <fate_die>: take it from the dice display if available; otherwise take it from a civilization with the most fate dice. Add it to your fate dice (rolled together for favor tests, hunts, and lucky finds).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 骰子展示区有<fate_die>。
<ontology::condition>.en: The dice display has a <fate_die>.

description.zh: 从展示区拿取 1 枚<fate_die>。
description.en: Take 1 fate die from the display.

description.zh: 将该<fate_die>加入自己持有的粉骰（之后恩惠检定、狩猎、幸运收获时一起掷）。
description.en: Add the fate die to your fate dice (rolled together for favor tests, hunts, and lucky finds).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 骰子展示区没有<fate_die>，且自己不是唯一拥有<fate_die>数量最多的玩家。
<ontology::condition>.en: The dice display has no <fate_die>, and you are not the only player with the most fate dice.

options.target: 除自己之外的 1 个 <ontology::player>（拥有<fate_die>数量最多的玩家；多人并列最多时由该玩家决定给出哪颗）

description.zh: 从拥有<fate_die>最多的玩家处拿取 1 枚<fate_die>。
description.en: Take 1 fate die from the civilization with the most.

description.zh: 将该<fate_die>加入自己持有的粉骰（之后恩惠检定、狩猎、幸运收获时一起掷）。
description.en: Add the fate die to your fate dice (rolled together for favor tests, hunts, and lucky finds).

description.zh: 从<progress_board>的<goal_chip_display>选择 1 枚<goal_chip>，正面朝上放入<goal_area>；<goal_area>已满时叠放在任意 1 枚已有<goal_chip>上并覆盖之（被覆盖者直到其上芯片被安装前不可用）。随后从<goal_chip_bag>随机抽 1 枚补满<goal_chip_display>空位。
description.en: Choose 1 <goal_chip> from the goal chip display on the progress board and place it face up in your goal area; if all 3 spaces are occupied, place it on top of another face-up goal chip, covering it. Then refill the empty display space with a goal chip randomly drawn from the dark blue bag.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 目标芯片展示区非空。
<ontology::condition>.en: The goal chip display is not empty.

triggers.target: 目标芯片展示区的 1 枚<goal_chip>

description.zh: 拿取 1 枚目标芯片正面朝上放入目标区（满时叠放覆盖）。
description.en: Take 1 goal chip face up into the goal area (stacked on top if full).

description.zh: 从<ontology::supply>取 N 个标记作为<planning_marker>，全部放到<console>任意 1 个<activation_dice_area>的格上（必须同一格，不能分散）。<planning_marker>可在<activate_module>时替代对应点数的<activation_die>支付费用。
description.en: Take N markers from supply as <planning_marker>s and place all of them onto any 1 dice space of your console (all on the same space). Planning markers may replace a white activation die of the corresponding value when activating a module.

triggers.target: 控制台任意 1 个骰子格

description.zh: 从供应堆取 N 个标记放到同一骰子格，成为计划标记。（标记放上骰子格后才成为<planning_marker>）
description.en: Place N markers from supply onto the same dice space as planning markers.(the marker becomes a <planning_marker> once on the dice space)

description.zh: 将 1 个<feature_marker>从当前<feature_space>移动到自己的任意其他<feature_space>。
description.en: Move 1 <feature_marker> from its current feature space to any other feature space of yours.

triggers.target: 1 个自己的<feature_marker> + 1 个自己的目标特征格

description.zh: 将该特征标记移至目标特征格。
description.en: Move the feature marker to the target feature space.

description.zh: 建造农场：选一个有自己<tribe>的陆地<territory>（不能已有<farm>，不能与已翻开的<volcano>相邻），将<console>的<farm_supply>的一个<farm>放至该<territory>。无需<stored_material>费用。立即获得 1 个<idea_marker>。最多 3 个，不可主动拆除。
description.en: Build a farm: Choose a land territory where you have at least one tribe, no farm exists (any player), and not adjacent to a face-up Volcano. Take a farm from the console farm supply and place it on the territory. No material cost. Immediately gain 1 idea marker. Max 3 per player; cannot be voluntarily demolished.

description.zh: 存在一片陆地区域（非水域）：有至少一个自己的<tribe>、没有任何<farm>（任何玩家）。
description.en: There exists a land territory (not Water): has at least one of your <tribe>s, no <farm> (any player).

description.zh: 控制台<farm_supply>中还有未建造的<farm>（已建造 < 3）。
description.en: <farm_supply> on the console still has an unbuilt <farm> (built < 3).

triggers.target: 有自己的<tribe>且没有任何<farm>的一片陆地区域（与已翻开的<volcano>相邻的区域被其永续效果排除，见<volcano>的连续效果）

description.zh: （标记放上创意格后才成为<idea_marker>）
description.en: (the marker becomes an <idea_marker> once on the idea space)

description.zh: 建造聚落：选一个<building_site>，从<console>的<settlement_zone>选一个未建造的<settlement>，支付其<stored_material>费用，将<settlement>放至<building_site>。立即获得 1 个<income_chip>并触发其效果。建造第 4 个<settlement>时可翻面一个未激活的<stage_tile>。
description.en: Build a settlement: Choose a Building ground, choose an unbuilt settlement from the console settlement zone, pay its material cost, and place it on the Building ground. Immediately gain 1 income chip and trigger its effect. When building the 4th, may flip an inactive stage tile.

description.zh: 存在一个<building_site>：与有自己<tribe>的区域相邻、且上面尚未建造自己的<settlement>。
description.en: There exists a <building_site> adjacent to a territory with your <tribe> and without your own <settlement> on it.

description.zh: 控制台<settlement_zone>中还有未建造的<settlement>（已建造 < 4）。
description.en: <settlement_zone> on the console still has an unbuilt <settlement> (built < 4).

quantity.zh: 因所选聚落格而异——各格材料清单见 <settlement_zone> 的 slots。
quantity.en: Varies by the chosen settlement slot — see each slot's material in <settlement_zone>.slots.

triggers.target: 一个与有自己的<tribe>区域相邻的<building_site>，且上面尚未建造自己的<settlement>

description.zh: 获得 1 个收入芯片并立即触发其效果。
description.en: Gain 1 income chip and immediately trigger its effect.

name.zh: 翻面层级板块（第 4 个聚落时可选）
name.en: Flip Stage Tile (optional when building the 4th)

<ontology::condition>.zh: 这是玩家建造的第 4 个聚落。
<ontology::condition>.en: This is the player's 4th built settlement.

description.zh: 不翻面（跳过）
description.en: Do not flip (skip)

<ontology::flip>.subject: 1 个未激活的层级四或层级五板块（<stage_tile>）

description.zh: 建造船：选一个与有自己<tribe>的<territory>相邻的水域（不能已有自己的<boat>），将<console>的<boat_supply>的一艘<boat>连带着船上的标记放至该水域。无需<stored_material>费用。立即将相邻<territory>中的一个站立<tribe><migrate>到<boat>上。最多 2 艘，不可主动拆除。
description.en: Build a boat: Choose a Water territory adjacent to a territory where you have at least one tribe and where you have no boat. Take a boat from the console boat supply (with its markers) and place it on the Water territory. No material cost. Immediately move one standing tribe from an adjacent territory onto the boat. Max 2 per player; cannot be voluntarily demolished.

description.zh: 存在一片水域：与有自己<tribe>的区域相邻、且该水域中没有自己的<boat>。
description.en: There exists a Water territory adjacent to a territory with your <tribe> and without your own <boat> on it.

description.zh: 控制台<boat_supply>中还有未建造的<boat>（已建造 < 2）。
description.en: <boat_supply> on the console still has an unbuilt <boat> (built < 2).

triggers.target: 一个与有自己的<tribe>区域相邻的<terrain_water>，且上面没有自己的<boat>

description.zh: 不做（跳过此项）
description.en: Skip this option

description.zh: 从相邻区域中选一个站立<tribe>，迁徙到刚放置的<boat>上。只有站立部落才能登船。
description.en: Choose a standing <tribe> from an adjacent territory and migrate it onto the newly placed <boat>. Only standing tribes may board.

description.zh: 建造雕像：选一个<building_site>（满足建造要求、未超建筑上限），从<building_site>上列出的 2~3 种<stored_material>中选一种，从<storage_area>取出一个对应标记作为<statue>放至<building_site>。可立即推进任意<progress_track> 1 格。每个<building_site>最多 2 个建筑（至多 1 个<settlement>），<statue>在后续<phase_8_income>按<favor_of_ager_track>计分。
description.en: Build a statue: Choose a Building ground (meeting building requirements, within build limit). Choose one of the 2-3 materials listed on it, take a marker of that type from storage, and place it as a statue on the Building ground. May immediately advance on any progress track by 1 step. Max 2 buildings per Building ground (max 1 settlement); each statue scores in subsequent Income phases based on the Favor of Agera track.

description.zh: <building_site>与有自己<tribe>的区域相邻（若为水域建造点，则需该水域有自己的<boat>且船上有<tribe>）。
description.en: The <building_site> is adjacent to a territory with your <tribe> (for a Water building ground, requires your <boat> with a <tribe> on it in that Water territory).

description.zh: 该<building_site>上自己的建筑少于 2 个。
description.en: You have fewer than 2 of your own buildings on this <building_site>.

description.zh: 仓库中有该<building_site>上列出的至少一种<stored_material>。
description.en: At least one of the <stored_material> types listed on this <building_site> is in your storage.

description.zh: 从建造点上列出的 2~3 种材料中选一种，将对应<stored_material>从仓库返还供应堆。
description.en: Choose one of the 2-3 materials listed on the Building ground, and return the corresponding <stored_material> from storage to the supply.

triggers.target: 一个满足建造要求的<building_site>，且其上列出的材料中至少有一种在仓库中

description.zh: 从供应堆取 1 个通用标记（<octagonal_pillar>）放至建造点，成为<statue>。
description.en: Take 1 generic marker (<octagonal_pillar>) from the supply and place it on the Building ground as a <statue>.

description.zh: 不做（跳过此项）
description.en: Skip this option

description.zh: 任选一条进程轨推进 1 格。
description.en: Advance on any progress track by 1 step.

description.zh: 激活一个层级板块：选择一个尚未激活的<stage_tile>（层级 4 或层级 5），将其翻至激活面。激活后该层级在<final_scoring>时生效。
description.en: Activate a stage tile: Choose an inactive <stage_tile> (stage 4 or stage 5) and flip it to its active face. Once activated, the stage scores during final scoring.

triggers.target: 一个未激活的<stage_tile>（层级 4 或层级 5）

description.zh: 选择 1 个有至少一个自己 <tribe> 的<territory>，从<ontology::supply>取 1 个标记作为 <stored_material> 放到<storage_area>中与所选<territory>地形类型对应的存储格。只按<territory>地形类型匹配，与<material_tile>印的具体材料无关。
description.en: Choose 1 land territory where you have at least one <tribe>, take 1 marker from supply as a <stored_material>, and place it on a storage space matching the chosen territory's terrain type. Only the territory type matters, not the material depicted on the material tile.

triggers.target: 1 个有至少一个自己 <tribe> 的陆地区域

description.zh: 从供应堆取 1 个标记作为 <stored_material>，放到仓库中与所选区域地形类型对应的存储格（该类型的 3 个存储格任选其一）——只按区域地形类型匹配，与材料板块印的具体材料无关。
description.en: Take 1 marker from supply as a <stored_material> and place it on a storage space matching the chosen territory's terrain type (any of that type's 3 storage spaces) — only the territory type matters, not the material depicted on the material tile.

description.zh: 选择 1 个自己的模组（<upgradable_module> 或 <feature_module>），支付该模组声明的费用（恰好 2 个对应点数的<activation_die>），执行其当前等级的效果。<planning_marker> 与 <focus_marker> 的替代在支付环节生效（见各自定义的 <ontology::substitution>，生效点：<ontology::pipeline> 的 pay_cost 步骤）。
