description.en: Choose 1 of your modules (<upgradable_module> main module or <feature_module> feature module): pay the module's declared cost (exactly 2 <activation_die>s of matching values), then execute its current-level effect. <planning_marker> / <focus_marker> substitutions apply during payment (see each marker's <ontology::substitution>; effective point: the pay_cost step of <ontology::pipeline>).

triggers.target: 1 个自己的模组（<upgradable_module> 或 <feature_module>）

description.zh: 可选：支付费用前，询问是否消耗<idea_marker>修改<activation_dice_area>上<activation_die>的点数（每 1 个 = ±1，1 和 6 相连），使点数满足<module>费用要求。
description.en: Optional: before paying the cost, ask whether to spend <idea_marker>s to modify <activation_die> values on dice spaces (each = ±1, 1 and 6 are adjacent) to meet the module's cost requirement.

description.zh: 不调整（跳过）
description.en: Skip (do not adjust)

options.<ontology::effect>: this.target 的 effect（其声明的 cost + 当前等级效果）

description.zh: 执行重置。前提：<activation_dice_area> 中剩余 ≤3 个 <activation_die>。将<reset_column>中最靠左的<reset_marker>沿列向下推进三步——A: 推动<phase_indicator>至下一个<reset_space>（到达红色格触发<action_phase_end>）；B: 回收所有已使用的<activation_die>重掷并放回点数格；C: 将该标记移入<idea_space>或<food_space>。所有<reset_column>均为空时仍可执行重置，但 C 步改为从<ontology::supply>拿取一个<octagonal_pillar>放置。
description.en: Perform a Reset. Precondition: ≤3 <activation_die> remaining in <activation_dice_area>. Push the leftmost <reset_marker> in the <reset_column>s down three steps — A: Advance the <phase_indicator> to the next reset space (red space triggers Action Phase end); B: Retrieve all used <activation_die>s, re-roll, and place on matching value spaces; C: Move the marker to <idea_space> or <food_space>. If all reset columns are empty, Reset can still be performed, but step C changes to taking a generic marker from supply instead.

<ontology::condition>.zh: <activation_dice_area> 中剩余 ≤3 个 <activation_die>。
<ontology::condition>.en: ≤3 <activation_die>s remaining in <activation_dice_area>.

description.zh: 将最靠左的<reset_marker>沿列下推一格（A 位）。沿黄色箭头推动<phase_indicator>至<phase_sequence>的下一个<reset_space>。若到达<reset_end_space>，触发<action_phase_end>。
description.en: Push the leftmost <reset_marker> one step down its column (position A). Advance the <phase_indicator> along the yellow arrow to the next <reset_space> on the <phase_sequence>. If it reaches the <reset_end_space>, trigger <action_phase_end>.

name.en: Step B: Retrieve and Re-roll Dice

description.zh: 将同一<reset_marker>沿列再下推一格（B 位）。回收<activation_dice_area>中所有已使用的<activation_die>，全部重掷，将每颗骰子放回与点数匹配的格上。
description.en: Push the same <reset_marker> another step down its column (position B). Retrieve all used <activation_die>s from <activation_dice_area>, re-roll all of them, and place each on its matching value space.

description.zh: 完成一个建造项目：从四种建造中选一种执行——<build_farm>、<build_boat>、<build_statue>、或<build_settlement>。
description.en: Complete a building project: Choose one of four building types to execute — build a farm, build a boat, build a statue, or build a settlement.

description.zh: <phase_indicator> 位于 <final_scoring_area_hex.<final_scoring_area_hex.point_bonus>（第 11 格，最后一格）——全部 11 格（9 类别 + 控制台 A/B）结算完毕。
description.en: The <phase_indicator> is on <final_scoring_area_hex.<final_scoring_area_hex.point_bonus> (the 11th and last cell) — all 11 cells (9 categories + Console A/B) have been scored.

<ontology::condition>.zh: <phase_indicator> 位于 <final_scoring_area_hex.<final_scoring_area_hex.point_bonus>
<ontology::condition>.en: The <phase_indicator> is on <final_scoring_area_hex.<final_scoring_area_hex.point_bonus>

description.zh: <phase_indicator> 位于 <phase_sequence>.<phase_4_action>[9]（第 10 格，<reset_end_space>，由<reset>的 A 步推入），**且自到达以来每位 <ontology::player> 又各完成了一个 <ontology::turn>**——即红格被推的那一轮与下一轮（最终行动轮）均已完成。
description.en: The <phase_indicator> is on <phase_sequence>.<phase_4_action>[9] (the 10th space, <reset_end_space>, pushed there by Reset step A), **and since it arrived every <ontology::player> has completed one more <ontology::turn>** — i.e. both the round in which the red space was reached and the following round (the final action round) are complete.

description.zh: 部落死亡结算：<phase_6_feeding>未喂饱的弱<tribe>（posture == <lying> 且未获得<food>）死亡、<phase_7_event>负面效果指定移除的<tribe>——统一结算为将 1 个<tribe>从<continent>返回<ontology::supply>（<remove_tribe>）。
description.en: Tribe death resolution: unfed weak tribes in the Feeding phase (posture == <lying> without food) and tribes targeted by negative event effects die — uniformly resolved as returning 1 <tribe> from the continent to the supply (<remove_tribe>).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本玩家的 1 个<tribe>死亡：喂养阶段未喂饱的弱部落，或事件阶段负面效果指定移除的部落。
<ontology::condition>.en: One of this player's <tribe>s dies: an unfed weak tribe in the Feeding phase, or a tribe targeted by a negative event effect.

triggers.target: 1 个死亡的<tribe>

description.zh: 当本玩家的 1 个<tribe>即将死亡（<tribe_death> 的 content 即将结算）时，可改用本行动改写该结算：<remove_tribe> 不再执行，改为将本玩家在<favor_of_ager_track>上的<favor_marker>向后移 1 步。若标记已在轨最左格则不能使用。
description.en: Whenever one of your <tribe>s is about to die (<tribe_death>'s content is about to resolve), you may instead use this action to rewrite that resolution: <remove_tribe> no longer executes; your marker on the <favor_of_ager_track> is moved one step backwards instead. Not possible if your marker is already on the leftmost space of the track.

<ontology::condition>.zh: <tribe_death>.content.<ontology::instant_content> 即将开始结算（本玩家的<tribe>即将死亡），且本玩家在<favor_of_ager_track>上的标记不在最左格。
<ontology::condition>.en: <tribe_death>.content.<ontology::instant_content> is about to resolve (one of this player's <tribe>s is about to die), and this player's marker on the <favor_of_ager_track> is not on the leftmost space.

triggers.target: 1 个即将死亡的<tribe>
